minimum_decisive_artifact: exact-spec rerun only after metric-definition drift
fail_condition: drifted metric removes or reverses the split
mixed_result_action: split old and new metric names; do not pool thresholds

first_field_to_check: same retained key has callback work, next-key work, and counterfactual placement
pass_condition: trace proves work-placement ordering, not just marker ordering
fail_condition: trace lacks counterfactual placement or only repeats marker alignment
waste_to_avoid: more marker-alignment rows called mechanism proof
mixed_result_action: keep ordering wording and list mechanism as unproved

minimum_decisive_artifact: representative replay strata with assertions and source spans
pass_condition: realistic strata reproduce the relevant effect and owners
fail_condition: tap/replay strata do not reproduce the held-key result
waste_to_avoid: more fixed-`x` held-key rows sold as product typing
mixed_result_action: scope claims to passing strata only

first_field_to_check: observer-off/on equality and per-key runtime field join
pass_condition: passive field separates retained classes without perturbing ordering
fail_condition: observer perturbs ordering or no field separates classes
waste_to_avoid: active DevTools checkpoint rows renamed as mechanism

minimum_decisive_artifact: accepted sidecar plus joined CPU/system counters
first_field_to_check: per-key counter window and clock synchronization
pass_condition: joined counters separate retained classes without perturbation
fail_condition: counters fail to separate, cannot join, or perturb scheduling
waste_to_avoid: aggregate latency movement renamed as frequency/QoS/cache cause

minimum_decisive_artifact: real Performance Tests topology startup-wait artifact
first_field_to_check: failures, resources, retained counts, and key-position tails
pass_condition: shorter wait preserves q50 and veto fields in target topology
fail_condition: q50 win comes with failures, resource shift, missing rows, or first-key tail regression
mixed_result_action: split retained typing, first-input, and idle-return metrics

minimum_decisive_artifact: predicate plus resource-quiet validation with per-spec veto gates
pass_condition: validated lane preserves workload and readiness while reducing wait
fail_condition: predicate/fallback moves measured work before timing or fails in a lane
waste_to_avoid: aggregate q50 wait removal without endpoint composition
mixed_result_action: change only passing lanes and keep fallback elsewhere

minimum_decisive_artifact: behavior fixtures plus targeted source-span before/after
first_field_to_check: behavior pass and targeted owner span collapse
pass_condition: behavior passes and targeted source span/fanout collapses before p50 claims
fail_condition: behavior changes or aggregate p50 moves without targeted source proof
mixed_result_action: rescope to another owner or keep prototype local

first_field_to_check: public subscriber, persistence, dependency, cross-store, and async semantics
pass_condition: compatibility passes and fanout collapse is isolated to safe classes
fail_condition: any public subscriber or ordering semantic changes
waste_to_avoid: private side-channel win treated as public API safety
mixed_result_action: restrict to private path or keep public semantics

minimum_decisive_artifact: synthetic and recorded workload replay strata
pass_condition: passing strata reproduce relevant owners/effects with assertions
fail_condition: strata show different owners, opposite effects, failures, or missing assertions
waste_to_avoid: more fixed-`x` samples called product coverage
mixed_result_action: report fixed-`x` and passing strata separately

pass_condition: external endpoint preserves ordering and joins retained keys without perturbation
fail_condition: endpoint disagrees, cannot join, or perturbs ordering
waste_to_avoid: calling Paint, DrawFrame, screenshot, or OCR physical display latency
mixed_result_action: name only the deepest passing endpoint

minimum_decisive_artifact: archived CI artifact to dashboard/reviewer policy join
first_field_to_check: raw q50 to dashboard threshold/noisy-metric/reviewer decision mapping
pass_condition: documented policy maps raw q50 movement to actual outcome
fail_condition: policy uses another statistic, threshold, noisy rule, or manual path
waste_to_avoid: local q50 movement called pass/fail behavior
mixed_result_action: report q50 evidence and leave gate semantics external
